_notice: DEMO & SAMPLE CAMPUS MAP DATA ONLY. This dataset provides illustrative walking paths and landmark distances for CampusMate AI demonstrations. It does not represent surveyor-verified distances or official campus architectural blueprints. To adapt this system for your actual institution, replace the nodes and edges below with verified campus building data.

locations.name: Main Gate
locations.description: Primary campus entrance with 24/7 security booth and visitor reception.

locations.name: Administrative Block
locations.description: Houses Examination Cell, Dean of Student Affairs, and Registrar Office.

locations.name: Central Courtyard
locations.description: Central landscaped hub featuring the landmark clock tower and covered walkways.

locations.name: Main Canteen
locations.description: Student cafeteria, snack stalls, and open-air seating beside the lawn.

locations.name: Central Library
locations.description: 3-story digital library, quiet reading floors, and journal archives.

locations.name: CSE Block
locations.description: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, software labs, and AI research wings.

locations.name: Main Laboratory Complex
locations.description: Hardware labs, electronics circuit suites, and physics/chemistry testing facilities.

locations.name: Mechanical Workshop
locations.description: Machine shop, welding bays, robotics fabrication facility, and thermal labs.

locations.name: Sports & Gymnasium Complex
locations.description: Indoor badminton courts, gym fitness suite, athletic field, and basketball arena.

locations.name: Campus Health Center
locations.description: 24/7 student dispensary, first-aid unit, and pharmacy.

locations.name: Student Activity Center (SAC)
locations.description: Headquarters for technical clubs, cultural societies, and hackathon co-working spaces.

edges.instruction_forward: Walk straight along the palm avenue from Main Gate toward the Administrative Block entrance.
edges.instruction_backward: Head west from the Administrative Block along the palm avenue toward the Main Gate exit.

edges.instruction_forward: Turn northwest along the shaded clinic path toward the Campus Health Center.
edges.instruction_backward: Head southeast toward the Administrative Block main foyer.

edges.instruction_forward: Proceed east through the covered colonnade past the Dean's lawn toward the Central Courtyard.
edges.instruction_backward: Follow the western colonnade walkway toward the Administrative Block.

edges.instruction_forward: Head south along the residential road leading to the Sports & Gymnasium Complex.
edges.instruction_backward: Walk north toward the Administrative Block.

edges.instruction_forward: Walk south past the clock tower and take the paved steps down to the Main Canteen plaza.
edges.instruction_backward: Walk north from the Main Canteen and head up toward the Central Courtyard Clock Tower.

edges.instruction_forward: Take the northeast tree-lined walkway directly toward the Central Library glass façade.
edges.instruction_backward: Head southwest from the Library main entrance back toward the Central Courtyard.

edges.instruction_forward: Walk east along the Academic Pedestrian Spine toward the CSE Block foyer.
edges.instruction_backward: Walk west along the Academic Spine toward the Central Courtyard.

edges.instruction_forward: Exit the south side of the Canteen and follow the covered walkway to the Main Laboratory Complex.
edges.instruction_backward: Exit the Main Lab and walk north past the juice stall into the Main Canteen.

edges.instruction_forward: Head west from the Canteen along the perimeter gravel lane to the Sports Complex entrance.
edges.instruction_backward: Walk east along the perimeter lane toward the Main Canteen.

edges.instruction_forward: Walk northeast along the tech corridor connecting the hardware labs to the CSE Block.
edges.instruction_backward: Walk southwest along the corridor from the CSE Block toward the Main Laboratory Complex.

edges.instruction_forward: Proceed east along the heavy machinery access road to the Mechanical Workshop bays.
edges.instruction_backward: Head west from the Mechanical Workshop toward the Main Laboratory entrance.

edges.instruction_forward: Head southeast from the library exit along the student promenade toward the SAC Building.
edges.instruction_backward: Walk northwest along the student promenade from SAC toward the Central Library.

edges.instruction_forward: Take the northern corridor from CSE Block directly into the Student Activity Center.
edges.instruction_backward: Take the southern corridor from the SAC exit back to the CSE Block entrance.

edges.instruction_forward: Head southeast across the engineering concourse toward the Mechanical Workshop gates.
edges.instruction_backward: Head northwest across the engineering concourse toward the CSE Block.
